description: The portfolio's configuration, extended by name rather than copied: the schedule, the labels and the Kotlin/kotlinx groups live in `github>youndie/sborka`.

`automerge-harness` is extended second, and the order matters - package rules are concatenated in the order the presets are named and the last match wins, so its rule has to come after the base preset's 'majors get a human'. Its precondition was checked rather than assumed: `.github/workflows/check.yaml` runs on `pull_request`, and B-14 watched it go red, so a harness bump is built before it merges itself.

The Java client and the broker are ONE version on purpose: `kafka-clients` is what the jvm arm delegates to and `apache/kafka` is what the suite runs against, and the catalogue says in as many words that they are the same release so the differential suite has one variable fewer.

Ungrouped, Renovate offers them as two pull requests, and taking one leaves the two arms measured against different Kafkas while every document still claims they agree. That is not a merge conflict - it is a claim that quietly stops being true.
